privacy_updated: This privacy policy was last updated: 6 November 2026
privacy_controller: This privacy policy explains how we collect and use (process) personal data on {site}. {operator}, represented by its managing director, is the data controller for the processing.
privacy_controller_serious: We take your privacy seriously, and we have taken several steps to make sure we give you clear information about how we process your data and which rights you have. If you feel that something is unclear or missing, do not hesitate to contact us.
privacy_rights_intro: Contact us if you have questions about or want to use one of your rights. You are entitled to an answer within 30 days at the latest. Read more on
privacy_rights_datatilsynet: the Norwegian Data Protection Authority's pages
privacy_right_access_lead: Access to and correction of your own data:
privacy_right_access: You can ask for a copy of all the data we process about you, and ask us to correct data that is not right.
privacy_right_erasure: In some situations you can ask us to erase and/or restrict the processing of data about yourself, but we cannot erase data we are required to process.
privacy_right_object: If we process data about you on the basis of a legitimate interest, you have the right to object to it.
privacy_right_portability: If we process data about you on the basis of consent or a contract, you can ask us to transfer data about you to you or to another controller.
privacy_right_withdraw: You have the right to withdraw your consent at any time. Press the button below to do so.
privacy_complaint: If you are not satisfied with how your data is processed, you can complain to the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet), but we hope you will tell us directly first so we can try to solve the matter for you in a good way. The Data Protection Authority's contact details are
privacy_subjects_attendees: Attendees at events, both members and guests
privacy_subjects_organisers: Members who log in and organize events
privacy_subjects_invited: People an organizer has noted as invited
privacy_collect_voluntary: Giving us personal data is voluntary, but to take part in events we do need a number of details from you.
privacy_collect_lead: We process personal data when you:
privacy_collect_invited: are noted as invited by an organizer
privacy_purpose_lead: Under article 6(1) of the General Data Protection Regulation, personal data may be processed on the basis of:
privacy_purpose_contract: An agreement we have entered into
privacy_purpose_vital: Protecting the vital interests of the data subject or another natural person
privacy_purpose_public: Performing a task in the public interest or exercising official authority
privacy_purpose_legitimate: A legitimate interest we believe we have
privacy_purpose_minimal: As a rule, personal data must not be processed and kept longer than necessary to fulfil the purpose of the processing. If we process your personal data on the basis of a legitimate interest we believe we have, you can object to the processing by contacting us. We will then consider your objection and answer you within a reasonable time.
privacy_keep: To meet GDPR requirements and save storage space, sign-ups and their data are deleted from our systems 30 days after the event has ended, with the event's list of what people can't eat and its list of who was invited.
privacy_processing_lead: Here we describe in detail when and how we process your personal data, for which purposes, on which legal basis and for how long.
privacy_signup_heading: You sign up for an event
privacy_signup_data: When you sign up for an event, we process your name and email address and, as a guest, your phone number and company if you give them. We also keep your answers to the event's questions, if it asks, and the language you signed up in. If you opened the event's page from an ad, we also keep which ad, from the codes in the address (UTM values and LinkedIn's or Meta's click id), with your sign-up. What you can't eat, if the event asks and you tell us, is kept for the event without your name. The purpose is to hold the event: organizers see who is coming and their answers, and the list of what people can't eat is used, without names, to plan.
privacy_signup_visible: Members who are logged in see who has signed up for events, with their details. Everyone else sees only how many.
privacy_signup_emails: We email you about your sign-up: that you are signed up, with a calendar invitation, if the time changes, if the event is cancelled, and a reminder the morning before if the event sends reminders. As a guest you can also ask for an email with a link to cancel.
privacy_signup_basis: The legal basis is legitimate interest, the legitimate interest being to hold the event. Your data is deleted 30 days after the event has ended, with no exception for evaluations or invitations to similar events. You can cancel until sign-up closes, and you can ask for deletion at any time. What you can't eat stays with the event when you cancel, since nothing ties it to you.
privacy_invited: An organizer can note your name and email address as invited. Nobody is emailed or signed up by it. The data is deleted with the sign-ups, 30 days after the event has ended. The legal basis is legitimate interest in the organizer being able to keep track of who is invited.
privacy_login: When you log in, we process your name, your email address and an id from where you log in, to know who you are. When you organize events, we also keep what you write, and who wrote what. The legal basis is legitimate interest in members being able to organize events.
privacy_use: When you use our website, we process personal data in line with the section on cookies below. The purpose is to run our website and improve the user experience. To stop bots and repeated attempts, the server counts sign-up and cancel attempts per IP address, in memory, for at most an hour.
privacy_use_basis: The legal basis is legitimate interest in running the website safely.
privacy_use_consent: The legal basis for cookies that store or process data is consent through the cookie banner on the website.
privacy_contacting: When you contact us by email, we process personal data such as your name and contact details so we can answer your enquiry.
privacy_contacting_basis: Legitimate interest in being able to answer enquiries.
privacy_sharing_heading: 7. Who we share personal data with
privacy_sharing_lead: To run our events site efficiently and safely, we sometimes have to share your personal data. We share personal data only when it is necessary, and only with:
privacy_shared_email: The provider that sends our emails
privacy_shared_login: The service members log in with
privacy_shared_hubspot: HubSpot, for visitor statistics and, if our HubSpot account collects forms, what a guest types into the sign-up form
privacy_shared_hubspot_sales: HubSpot, to which the name, email, company, job title, the ad they came from and whether they asked for invitations and the newsletter of those who sign up to our sales events are sent
privacy_shared_hubspot_and_sales: HubSpot, for visitor statistics, for what a guest types into the sign-up form if our HubSpot account collects forms, and for the name, email, company, job title, the ad they came from and whether they asked for invitations and the newsletter of those who sign up to our sales events
privacy_shared_authorities: Public authorities we are obliged to report to
privacy_sharing_agreements: All third parties are obliged to protect the data through data processing agreements where necessary and in line with the GDPR.
privacy_security_lead: We take information security seriously, and we will always do our utmost to look after your personal data in the best possible way. Among other things, we use:
privacy_security_login: logging in through an external login service, so we keep no passwords
privacy_security_domains: only letting in accounts from the allowed domains
privacy_security_guest_link: a signed link as the only way to your sign-up as a guest
privacy_security_purpose: to protect our data and stop unauthorized people from seeing, changing, deleting or in any way affecting the data we keep, including your personal data.
privacy_security_providers: We use only recognized providers of IT and administration services, and give access to personal data only where strictly necessary (for example for IT support).
privacy_cookies_lead: We use cookies on the website to improve functionality and the user experience. This includes:
privacy_cookies_necessary: For the website to work: one that keeps you logged in, some short-lived ones while you log in, and one that remembers the language you pick
privacy_cookies_analytics: To understand how the website is used (HubSpot)
privacy_cookies_browser: Your browser also keeps the theme you pick and, if you signed up as a guest, the link to your sign-up. If you opened an event's page from an ad, your browser keeps the codes of that ad for the event, whatever you choose about cookies. Organizers also have copies of the events they open kept in the browser.
privacy_cookies_change: You can change your cookie preferences at any time through the cookie banner on the website.
privacy_contact_lead: For enquiries about the rights of the data subject, you can contact us at:
